messages:
maria: quick ping on a proposed change to analytics.storage.schema: moving per-route/per-window timeseries into a compact 'envelope' + summary index. goal: reduce read amplification for the console and cut storage by ~35%.
leo: can you paste the schema diff?
maria: gist -> https://gist.github.com/redwood/compact-envelopes (top-level: analytics.quotas_envelope(id, route_id, window_start, summary_metrics, payload_jsonb))
vikram: how will existing aggregations that expect one-row-per-interval work? our OLAP jobs join on route_id + interval
maria: we plan to maintain a projection table analytics.quota_timeseries (materialized view populated by a transform worker) during migration. consumers can either read the projection or the new summary depending on SLA.
leo: materialized view sounds expensive. what's the write pattern during dual-write?
maria: dual-write from api -> write both legacy timeseries row and new envelope. transform worker gradually compacts legacy rows into envelopes and validates checksums before deleting old rows.
product-ux: product needs a migration UX plan for the console. admins should see a banner and opt into compact mode while we validate.
maria: agreed. draft UX: admin banner with rollout slider (0-100% routes), per-customer opt-out toggle, and a link to migration logs.
ops-bot: background job scheduled: quota-envelope-validate/partition-0 -> 2026-05-10T02:00:00Z
vikram: validation is important. propose we emit telemetry metrics quota_migration.diff_rate and quota_migration.delta_bytes to monitor divergence and space savings
leo: also add quota_api.read_latency.* metrics so we can detect regressions on enforcement path
maria: enforcement path will read a small indexed table quota_index(route_id, window_start, allowed, used) kept in sync during compaction. reads should be unaffected.
trace: question about downstream analytics consumers (billing pipeline). They currently rely on per-row event ids for dedupe and attribution
maria: we'll preserve legacy_row_id in migration_audit mapping and carry a checksum into the envelope. billing pipeline can switch to reading envelope or continue consuming the timeseries projection until cutover.
vikram: backfill strategy? full table rewriter will blow IOPS again
maria: propose incremental sharded backfill with a fast-change detector. steps: (1) compute route-level fingerprint, (2) only process routes with fingerprint delta, (3) compact those into envelopes, write migration_audit entries. pseudocode:
```
-- shard selection
SELECT route_id FROM analytics.timeseries_legacy WHERE mod(hashtext(route_id), 1024) = $shard;
-- compute fingerprint per route
WITH f AS (
  SELECT route_id, md5(string_agg(concat(interval_start,':',count,':',sum_tokens), '')) AS fp
  FROM analytics.timeseries_legacy GROUP BY route_id
)
-- compare to existing envelope fp and pick changed routes
```
product-ux: what's the expected window for dual-write? we need at least one billing cycle plus 48h for drift checks
maria: recommended dual-write window: 14 days. canary: 0.5% of routes for 24h, then 5% for 48h, then ramp.
leo: how are we handling schema evolution for dashboards? field names must remain stable
maria: emit compatibility fields quota_summary_v1 and quota_summary_v2 for telemetry during the migration window. dashboards can be toggled to read v2.
trace: how to audit customer-visible changes? customers will ask for migration proof
maria: we add analytics.migration_audit(route_id, old_row_count, new_envelope_id, checksum, migrated_at, migrated_by). admin console exposes this table read-only to enterprise teams.
vikram: rollback path? if we detect divergence above threshold, we need to pause compaction and rehydrate timeseries for affected routes
maria: rollback plan: pause compactor, use migration_audit to find envelopes created in the window, run rehydrate job to recreate legacy rows, re-enable reads to legacy table, keep dual-write for 48h, then demote envelope writes
leo: tests? need integration tests for idempotency, checksum mismatch, partial compaction, and scale perf
maria: adding those to the PR checklist. also adding a chaos test that kills compactor mid-route.
product-ux: also need copy for admin banner that explains the risks and provides contact escalation path
maria: will draft. PR to add schema + dual-write hooks + migration tooling tonight. tagging infra/analytics/product-ux/release for review.
ops-bot: job started: quota-envelopes-backfill/shard-0 (eta ~ 4h) https://ci.redwood.run/jobs/quota-envelopes-backfill/1739991234
leo: +1 infra pending load tests, watch iops cap on DB
vikram: +1 analytics, please add projection consumer tests for billing pipeline
trace: +1 observability, add alerts: quota_migration.diff_rate > 0.2% sustained 1h and quota_api.read_latency.p50 increase > 20%
product-ux: +1 on UX plan, will prep banner copy and helpdesk blurb
maria: thanks all. i'll open PR and include a rollout checklist with metrics gates and rollback steps.
